howtos.title: Ask how to make the change fully verifiable
howtos.what: Matt Pocock's one-line prompt that forces coding agents to prove changes end-to-end, including real signups and UI clicks.
copy: How do we make this change fully verifiable?
howtos.whenToUse: When a coding agent claims a fix is done and you want it to verify behavior for real, not just assert success.

howtos.title: Patch Alpine musl SSH password auth now
howtos.what: Mitigate the musl OpenSSH bug where locked accounts accept any password longer than 256 characters on Alpine cloud images.
copy: On Alpine or other musl boxes running OpenSSH without PAM, upgrade openssh: apk upgrade openssh (OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes the bug).
Or disable password auth: set PasswordAuthentication no in sshd_config and reload sshd.
Treat default alpine users on official AWS/Azure images as exposed until upgraded; they are '*'-locked with passwordless doas.
howtos.whenToUse: When you run agent boxes, Docker hosts, or cloud VMs on Alpine/musl with password SSH enabled.
